req.prompt:
Maximum party policy: no booking may be for more than 8 people, whatever the table. Add it to src/booking/commands/create_booking.rs and src/web/bookings/failures.rs, with a test in src/web/bookings/routes.rs that the web refuses such a booking.

Keep cargo test and cargo clippy (-D warnings) passing. Do not run anything; just edit. No new comments. Reply with one line saying what you changed.

result: I added a `PartyOverLimit` failure (max 8, checked before the table-size check) to `create_booking.rs`, mapped it to 422 in `failures.rs`, and added a routes test using a 12-seat table that expects a party of 9 to be refused and a party of 8 to be accepted. I haven't compiled or run anything, so `cargo test` and `cargo clippy` are untested.
